name: Administrative assistants and executive assistants
oneLiner: Scheduling, drafting and coordinating — the exact activities appearing most in real AI usage.
why: Trust and discretion still matter: the assistant knows things the org chart does not
Someone must coordinate people who will not coordinate themselves

claims.text: Administrative assistants appear among the roles employers expect to decline sharply to 2030.
The most common and most successful AI-assisted activities are information work — creating, processing and communicating information.
The ILO's refined index places clerical support work in the highest exposure gradients.
